```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

*Purpose:*
To map the luminex cytokine multiplex assay results into a single heatmap to show highly expressed and low expressed cytokines across multiple patient cSDH samples.

```{r}
## ---- 1. Packages ------------------------------------------------------------
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("BiocManager")
if (!requireNamespace("ComplexHeatmap", quietly = TRUE)) BiocManager::install("ComplexHeatmap", update = FALSE, ask = FALSE)
if (!requireNamespace("circlize", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("circlize")
if (!requireNamespace("viridisLite", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("viridisLite")

library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(viridisLite)
library(grid)

## ---- 2. Load data -----------------------------------------------------------
# setwd("~/Documents/Claude/Projects/cSDH paper")   # uncomment / edit if needed
df <- read.csv("csdh_heatmap_data.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

patient_levels  <- c("Pt 43", "Pt 44", "Pt 45", "Pt 74", "Pt 77")
category_levels <- unique(df[order(df$category_order), "category"])

## ---- 3. Reshape to matrices -------------------------------------------------
analytes <- unique(df$analyte[order(df$category_order)])

conc_mat   <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(analytes), ncol = length(patient_levels),
                     dimnames = list(analytes, patient_levels))
status_mat <- matrix("ND",     nrow = length(analytes), ncol = length(patient_levels),
                     dimnames = list(analytes, patient_levels))
lod_vec    <- setNames(rep(NA_real_, length(analytes)), analytes)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(df))) {
  a <- df$analyte[i]; p <- df$patient[i]
  status_mat[a, p] <- df$status[i]
  if (!is.na(df$concentration[i]) && df$concentration[i] != "")
    conc_mat[a, p] <- as.numeric(df$concentration[i])
  if (!is.na(df$LoD[i]) && df$LoD[i] != "") lod_vec[a] <- as.numeric(df$LoD[i])
}

# Per-analyte metadata (category kept only for the optional color side-bar)
meta <- df[!duplicated(df$analyte), c("analyte", "category")]
rownames(meta) <- meta$analyte
meta <- meta[analytes, ]
row_category <- factor(meta$category, levels = category_levels)

# log10 transform for the color scale (values span several orders of magnitude)
log_mat <- log10(conc_mat)

## ---- 4. Hierarchical clustering ---------------------------------------------
# Clustering cannot use NA (non-detect) cells, so build a separate matrix in
# which non-detects are imputed to log10(LoD/2) -- a standard low substitution.
# The DISPLAYED matrix (log_mat) is untouched; non-detects still render grey.
impute_mat <- log_mat
for (a in rownames(impute_mat)) {
  na_j <- which(is.na(impute_mat[a, ]))
  if (length(na_j)) {
    floor_val <- if (!is.na(lod_vec[a])) log10(lod_vec[a] / 2) else min(log_mat, na.rm = TRUE)
    impute_mat[a, na_j] <- floor_val
  }
}

# --- Clustering options (defaults: euclidean distance, complete linkage) ------
# To cluster analytes by co-variation PATTERN across patients rather than by
# absolute abundance, uncomment the scaling line below (row z-scores).
clust_input <- impute_mat
# clust_input <- t(scale(t(impute_mat)))   # <- optional: per-analyte z-score

row_dend <- as.dendrogram(hclust(dist(clust_input,       method = "euclidean"), method = "complete"))

## ---- 5. Colors --------------------------------------------------------------
rng     <- range(log_mat, na.rm = TRUE)
col_fun <- colorRamp2(seq(rng[1], rng[2], length.out = 256), magma(256))

## ---- 6. Per-cell overlay: nd text for ND, corner asterisk for BLOQ ----------
cell_fun <- function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
  st <- status_mat[i, j]
  if (st == "ND") {
    grid.rect(x, y, width, height, gp = gpar(fill = "#dcdcdc", col = "white", lwd = 0.5))
    grid.text("nd", x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 6, col = "#888888"))
  } else if (st == "BLOQ") {
    # small asterisk in the TOP-RIGHT corner
    grid.text("*",
              x + width * 0.34, y + height * 0.10,
              gp = gpar(fontsize = 11, fontface = "bold", col = "white"))
  }
}

## ---- 7. Build heatmap -------------------------------------------------------
ht <- Heatmap(
  log_mat,
  name              = "log10\n(pg/mL)",
  col               = col_fun,
  na_col            = "#dcdcdc",
  cluster_rows      = row_dend,
  cluster_columns   = FALSE,
  row_dend_width    = unit(15, "mm"),
  column_names_rot  = 0,
  column_names_centered = TRUE,
  column_names_gp   = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  row_names_gp      = gpar(fontsize = 7.5),
  row_names_side    = "right",
  cell_fun          = cell_fun,
  border            = TRUE,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title_gp  = gpar(fontsize = 8, fontface = "bold"),
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7),
    legend_height = unit(3, "cm")
  ),
  column_title = "cSDH fluid protein profile (n = 5 patients; hierarchical clustering)\n* = below LLoQ (semi-quantitative);  nd = not detected",
  column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold")
)

## ---- 8. Export --------------------------------------------------------------
pdf("Figure1A_heatmap.pdf", width = 5, height = 9)
draw(ht, heatmap_legend_side = "right", annotation_legend_side = "right",
     merge_legends = TRUE, padding = unit(c(4, 4, 4, 4), "mm"))
dev.off()

png("Figure1A_heatmap.png", width = 5, height = 9, units = "in", res = 300)
draw(ht, heatmap_legend_side = "right", annotation_legend_side = "right",
     merge_legends = TRUE, padding = unit(c(4, 4, 4, 4), "mm"))
dev.off()

message("Done: Figure1A_heatmap.pdf and Figure1A_heatmap.png written.")
```

Same, but landscape:
```{r}
## ---- 1. Packages ------------------------------------------------------------
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("BiocManager")
if (!requireNamespace("ComplexHeatmap", quietly = TRUE)) BiocManager::install("ComplexHeatmap", update = FALSE, ask = FALSE)
if (!requireNamespace("circlize", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("circlize")
if (!requireNamespace("viridisLite", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("viridisLite")
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(viridisLite)
library(grid)
## ---- 2. Load data -----------------------------------------------------------
# setwd("~/Documents/Claude/Projects/cSDH paper")   # uncomment / edit if needed
df <- read.csv("csdh_heatmap_data.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
patient_levels  <- c("Pt 43", "Pt 44", "Pt 45", "Pt 74", "Pt 77")
category_levels <- unique(df[order(df$category_order), "category"])
## ---- 3. Reshape to matrices -------------------------------------------------
analytes <- unique(df$analyte[order(df$category_order)])
conc_mat   <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(analytes), ncol = length(patient_levels),
                     dimnames = list(analytes, patient_levels))
status_mat <- matrix("ND",     nrow = length(analytes), ncol = length(patient_levels),
                     dimnames = list(analytes, patient_levels))
lod_vec    <- setNames(rep(NA_real_, length(analytes)), analytes)
for (i in seq_len(nrow(df))) {
  a <- df$analyte[i]; p <- df$patient[i]
  status_mat[a, p] <- df$status[i]
  if (!is.na(df$concentration[i]) && df$concentration[i] != "")
    conc_mat[a, p] <- as.numeric(df$concentration[i])
  if (!is.na(df$LoD[i]) && df$LoD[i] != "") lod_vec[a] <- as.numeric(df$LoD[i])
}
# Per-analyte metadata (category kept only for the optional color side-bar)
meta <- df[!duplicated(df$analyte), c("analyte", "category")]
rownames(meta) <- meta$analyte
meta <- meta[analytes, ]
row_category <- factor(meta$category, levels = category_levels)
# log10 transform for the color scale (values span several orders of magnitude)
log_mat <- log10(conc_mat)
## ---- 4. Hierarchical clustering ---------------------------------------------
# Clustering cannot use NA (non-detect) cells, so build a separate matrix in
# which non-detects are imputed to log10(LoD/2) -- a standard low substitution.
# The DISPLAYED matrix (log_mat) is untouched; non-detects still render grey.
impute_mat <- log_mat
for (a in rownames(impute_mat)) {
  na_j <- which(is.na(impute_mat[a, ]))
  if (length(na_j)) {
    floor_val <- if (!is.na(lod_vec[a])) log10(lod_vec[a] / 2) else min(log_mat, na.rm = TRUE)
    impute_mat[a, na_j] <- floor_val
  }
}
# --- Clustering options (defaults: euclidean distance, complete linkage) ------
# To cluster analytes by co-variation PATTERN across patients rather than by
# absolute abundance, uncomment the scaling line below (row z-scores).
clust_input <- impute_mat
# clust_input <- t(scale(t(impute_mat)))   # <- optional: per-analyte z-score
analyte_dend <- as.dendrogram(hclust(dist(clust_input, method = "euclidean"), method = "complete"))
## ---- 5. Colors --------------------------------------------------------------
rng     <- range(log_mat, na.rm = TRUE)
col_fun <- colorRamp2(seq(rng[1], rng[2], length.out = 256), magma(256))
## ---- 6. Per-cell overlay: nd text for ND, corner asterisk for BLOQ ----------
# Display matrix is transposed (patients = rows, analytes = cols), so a display
# cell at row i (patient), col j (analyte) maps to status_mat[analyte j, patient i].
cell_fun <- function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
  st <- status_mat[j, i]
  if (st == "ND") {
    grid.rect(x, y, width, height, gp = gpar(fill = "#dcdcdc", col = "white", lwd = 0.5))
    grid.text("nd", x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 6, col = "#888888"))
  } else if (st == "BLOQ") {
    # small asterisk in the TOP-RIGHT corner
    grid.text("*",
              x + width * 0.2, y + height * 0.10,
              gp = gpar(fontsize = 11, fontface = "bold", col = "white"))
  }
}
## ---- 7. Build heatmap (transposed = horizontal) -----------------------------
ht <- Heatmap(
  t(log_mat),                       # patients = rows, analytes = columns
  name               = "log10\n(pg/mL)",
  col                = col_fun,
  na_col             = "#dcdcdc",
  cluster_rows       = FALSE,        # patients: keep given order
  cluster_columns    = analyte_dend, # analytes: clustered, dendrogram on top
  column_dend_height = unit(15, "mm"),
  column_names_rot   = 90,           # analyte labels vertical along the bottom
  column_names_gp    = gpar(fontsize = 7.5),
  column_names_side  = "bottom",
  row_names_gp       = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  row_names_side     = "left",
  cell_fun           = cell_fun,
  border             = TRUE,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title_gp  = gpar(fontsize = 8, fontface = "bold"),
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7),
    legend_height = unit(4, "cm")
  ),
  column_title = "cSDH fluid protein profile (n = 5 patients; hierarchical clustering)\n* = below LLoQ (semi-quantitative);  nd = not detected",
  column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold")
)
## ---- 8. Export (landscape) --------------------------------------------------
pdf("Figure1A_heatmap_horizontal.pdf", width = 10, height = 3)
draw(ht, heatmap_legend_side = "right", annotation_legend_side = "right",
     merge_legends = TRUE, padding = unit(c(4, 4, 4, 4), "mm"))
dev.off()
png("Figure1A_heatmap_horizontal.png", width = 10, height = 3, units = "in", res = 300)
draw(ht, heatmap_legend_side = "right", annotation_legend_side = "right",
     merge_legends = TRUE, padding = unit(c(4, 4, 4, 4), "mm"))
dev.off()
message("Done: Figure1A_heatmap.pdf and Figure1A_heatmap.png written.")
```

Just the cytokines that were above the LLoQ:
```{r}
## ---- 1. Packages ------------------------------------------------------------
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("BiocManager")
if (!requireNamespace("ComplexHeatmap", quietly = TRUE)) BiocManager::install("ComplexHeatmap", update = FALSE, ask = FALSE)
if (!requireNamespace("circlize", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("circlize")
if (!requireNamespace("viridisLite", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("viridisLite")
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(viridisLite)
library(grid)

## ---- 2. Load data -----------------------------------------------------------
# setwd("~/Documents/Claude/Projects/cSDH paper")   # uncomment / edit if needed
df <- read.csv("csdh_heatmap_data.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
patient_levels  <- c("Pt 43", "Pt 44", "Pt 45", "Pt 74", "Pt 77")
category_levels <- unique(df[order(df$category_order), "category"])
## ---- 3. Reshape to matrices -------------------------------------------------
analytes <- unique(df$analyte[order(df$category_order)])
conc_mat   <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(analytes), ncol = length(patient_levels),
                     dimnames = list(analytes, patient_levels))
status_mat <- matrix("ND",     nrow = length(analytes), ncol = length(patient_levels),
                     dimnames = list(analytes, patient_levels))
lod_vec    <- setNames(rep(NA_real_, length(analytes)), analytes)
for (i in seq_len(nrow(df))) {
  a <- df$analyte[i]; p <- df$patient[i]
  status_mat[a, p] <- df$status[i]
  if (!is.na(df$concentration[i]) && df$concentration[i] != "")
    conc_mat[a, p] <- as.numeric(df$concentration[i])
  if (!is.na(df$LoD[i]) && df$LoD[i] != "") lod_vec[a] <- as.numeric(df$LoD[i])
}

# --- Keep only analytes quantified (>= LLoQ) in ALL 5 patients ---------------
keep <- analytes[apply(status_mat[analytes, patient_levels, drop = FALSE], 1,
                       function(s) all(s == "QUANT"))]
analytes   <- keep
conc_mat   <- conc_mat[analytes, , drop = FALSE]
status_mat <- status_mat[analytes, , drop = FALSE]
lod_vec    <- lod_vec[analytes]
# log10 transform for the color scale (values span several orders of magnitude)
log_mat <- log10(conc_mat)

## ---- 4. Hierarchical clustering ---------------------------------------------
# Every cell is quantitative (no NAs), so cluster on log_mat directly.
# --- Clustering options (defaults: euclidean distance, complete linkage) ------
# To cluster analytes by co-variation PATTERN across patients rather than by
# absolute abundance, uncomment the scaling line below (row z-scores).
clust_input <- log_mat
# clust_input <- t(scale(t(log_mat)))   # <- optional: per-analyte z-score
analyte_dend <- as.dendrogram(hclust(dist(clust_input, method = "euclidean"), method = "complete"))

## ---- 5. Colors --------------------------------------------------------------
rng     <- range(log_mat, na.rm = TRUE)
col_fun <- colorRamp2(seq(rng[1], rng[2], length.out = 256), magma(256))

## ---- 6. Build heatmap (transposed = horizontal) -----------------------------
ht <- Heatmap(
  t(log_mat),                       # patients = rows, analytes = columns
  name               = "log10\n(pg/mL)",
  col                = col_fun,
  na_col             = "#dcdcdc",
  cluster_rows       = FALSE,        # patients: keep given order
  cluster_columns    = analyte_dend, # analytes: clustered, dendrogram on top
  column_dend_height = unit(15, "mm"),
  column_names_rot   = 90,           # analyte labels vertical along the bottom
  column_names_gp    = gpar(fontsize = 12),
  column_names_side  = "bottom",
  row_names_gp       = gpar(fontsize = 12),
  row_names_side     = "left",
  border             = TRUE,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title_gp  = gpar(fontsize = 8, fontface = "bold"),
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7),
    legend_height = unit(3, "cm")
  ),
  column_title = "cSDH fluid protein profile (n = 5 patients; hierarchical clustering)\nAnalytes quantified >= LLoQ in all 5 patients",
  column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold")
)
## ---- 7. Export (landscape) --------------------------------------------------
pdf("Figure1A_heatmap_aboveLLoQ.pdf", width = 8, height = 5)
draw(ht, heatmap_legend_side = "right", annotation_legend_side = "right",
     merge_legends = TRUE, padding = unit(c(4, 4, 4, 4), "mm"))
dev.off()
png("Figure1A_heatmap_aboveLLoQ.png", width = 8, height = 5, units = "in", res = 300)
draw(ht, heatmap_legend_side = "right", annotation_legend_side = "right",
     merge_legends = TRUE, padding = unit(c(4, 4, 4, 4), "mm"))
dev.off()
message("Done: Figure1A_heatmap.pdf and Figure1A_heatmap.png written.")
```
